mechanism.name: Wei：右删失依从者生存分位数IV

sampling.unit: 独立个体，保留右删失观察过程
sampling.dependence: iid individuals; latent compliance stratum independent of the IV-generation noise given X. Given X2, censoring is generated independently; observed W=min(T,C), E=1(T<=C). No latent stratum, uncensored T or C exported.

assumptions: 给定X的IV独立、排除、相关、正性、单调无defier；条件独立删失；所选分位数可辨识；不是总体ATE或风险比

properties.notes: X1,X2 both active; IV propensity includes X1^2 and X1*X2; exp survival map; H contains treatment times exp(.3*u). No latent stratum, censoring time or uncensored T is exported. Baseline-dimension convention: p=2, effective_p=2, baseline_columns=['X1', 'X2']; instruments, posttreatment variables, time points and network nodes are excluded. Reference sample size n_ref=128 independent subjects (the CPU interface-check setting), p/n_ref=0.01562500; high_dimensional=false refers to baseline p in this stated setting, not the full observed-column count. n remains a runtime argument; reassess the dimension/sample-size regime if n or p changes rather than treating this tag as a guarantee for arbitrary scaling.

estimand.name: CQCE(.5)
estimand.definition: CQCE(.5)：条件complier的log生存时间中位数，处理1减0；G为.5，H为.5 exp(.15)。

truth.expression: CQCE(.5)：条件complier的log生存时间中位数，处理1减0；G为.5，H为.5 exp(.15)。
truth.derivation: Analytic complier log-time quantile treatment contrast: effect for G and effect*exp(.3*tau) for H, checked by independent CDF inversion and controlled full observation-process draws.
